text: MITRA AI - Health-only research corpus; verify current official eligibility Page 1 MITRA AI - Health Schemes, Programmes & Service Initiatives 156 health-focused Government of India schemes, national programmes, public-health missions, service initiatives and access programmes for use as a structured research/RAG corpus Scope and methodology This corpus is intentionally health-only. It was assembled from current/official Government of India programme directories and department sources, then organised into practical health categories for a citizen-facing scheme assistant. The corpus includes direct beneficiary schemes as well as public-health programmes and service initiatives because the official health ecosystem contains both kinds of government interventions. Not every item is an individual cash/application scheme; some are facility-, community-, or population-level health programmes. For each item, the requested fields are provided: scheme/programme name, category, key benefits, eligibility or target group, and gender eligibility. Eligibility is intentionally summarised at a high level and should be checked against the current official guideline and local/state implementation before MITRA gives a final user-facing eligibility answer. Research basis Primary official source families used include the National Health Mission (maternal, child, adolescent, immunisation, family planning, NCD, health-system and communicable-disease programmes), the National Centre for Disease Control, the Central Tuberculosis Division, the National AIDS Control Organisation, the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, the Ministry of AYUSH, the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, and PMSSY. Examples of current official directories confirming the breadth of the health programme ecosystem include NHM's NCD programme directory, NHM's child/adolescent/immunisation/family-planning pages, NCDC's national health programme directory, and the Ministry of AYUSH scheme portal.
